understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' on each level without dying (especially by landing on spikes), completing levels within the limited turns/attempts to ultimately win the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose a horizontal action (MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT) or CLICK/UNDO. After any horizontal move, gravity automatically carries the player in the current gravity direction until they land on a solid/support tile (o/m/w), hit a hazard (u/v spikes) which immediately ends the attempt, or reach the '+' goal. CLICK removes a targeted breakable/clickable block (x) to open or alter fall paths and does not move the player. UNDO reverts the prior action. Planning relies on the predicted left/right landing positions and corridor scan to pick safe moves, favoring passage columns that change the y-level/section.
